name: credit-violation
description: The server set sharedCredit and leaseCredit to the minimum, 16384. The client's first Bytes chunk uses all of it (remaining 0); sending another chunk with data is a credit violation. The callee answers Error(protocol_error), which finishes its half, and the caller sends End next (7.1, 7.4).

given.session: established as in scenario handshake-normal (steps 1-3), with no call open
